nodetypes.name: dynports.kit.Panel
nodetypes.docs: A panel whose list options appear only when it is in list mode.

ports.name: cssClassName
ports.description: Extra CSS class names to put on this element, for styling from a stylesheet you supply

ports.name: styleCss
ports.description: Raw CSS declarations applied to this element, overriding the styling ports above

ports.name: variant
ports.description: Name of a saved variant of this node type to apply, replacing the styling set here

ports.name: mounted
ports.description: Removes the element from the page entirely when false, unlike Visible which leaves its space behind

ports.name: childIndex
ports.description: This element's position among its parent's children, counting from 0

ports.name: this
ports.description: A reference to this node itself, for ports that take a node rather than a value

ports.name: screenPositionX
ports.description: Distance in pixels from the left edge of the window to this element's left edge

ports.name: screenPositionY
ports.description: Distance in pixels from the top edge of the window to this element's top edge

ports.name: boundingWidth
ports.description: Width this element actually ended up with after layout, in pixels

ports.name: boundingHeight
ports.description: Height this element actually ended up with after layout, in pixels

ports.name: didMount
ports.description: Fires once this element has been added to the page and can be measured

ports.name: willUnmount
ports.description: Fires just before this element is removed from the page, while it still exists

ports.name: childrenCount
ports.description: How many child elements are currently mounted inside this one
